risk.reason: Broken links could hide evidence. Confined direct aliases and hash checks control this risk.

reason: Replace byte-identical screenshot copies with direct relative symbolic links to unchanged tracked regular sources.
path_rule: Source and alias paths are relative to scope. Each group SHA-256 and byte count applies to every listed path.
link_rule: The link target is os.path.relpath(scope/source, parent(scope/alias)). No absolute targets or link chains exist.

recovery.untracked_original: Read scope/source and verify the group SHA-256 before restoring the alias as a regular file.
recovery.source_policy: Keep each regular source while any recorded alias consumes it.

storage.git_limit: Git already shares identical blobs. Symbolic links reduce checkout storage, not historical push objects.
